title: Yara and the Crown
author: Ivo Hartwell
blurb: Bram Almeida, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
